title: SD PUC Order — Docket EL26-002: In the Matter of MidAmerican Energy Company’s Application for Approval of Its 2025 Reconciliation and 2026 Transmission Cost Recovery Factors (Order Approving Tariff Revisions)
text:
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION 
OF THE STATE OF SOUTH DAKOTA 
IN 
THE MATTER OF 
MIDAMERICAN 
ENERGY 
) 
COMPANY'S APPLICATION FOR APPROVAL OF ITS 
) 
2025 RECONCILIATION AND 2026 TRANSMISSION 
) 
COST RECOVERY FACTORS 
) 
ORDER APPROVING TARIFF 
REVISIONS 
EL26-002 
On February 13, 2026, the South Dakota Public Utilities Commission (Commission) received 
MidAmerican Energy Company's (MidAmerican) filing for approval of tariff revisions regarding its Transmission 
Cost Recovery (TCR) 2025 Reconciliation and 2026 New Factor Calculation. MidAmerican's TCR mechanism 
was established in the company's most recent rate case, EL 14-072. With this filing, MidAmerican is establishing 
new TCR rates based on true ups to the actual over/under recovery from 2025, 2026 forecasted Midcontinent 
Independent System Operator transmission expense, and the forecasted over/under recovery for January 
through March of 2026. MidAmerican requests the new TCR factors have an effective date of April 2, 2026. 
On February 19, 2026, the Commission electronically transmitted notice of the filing and the intervention 
deadline of March 6, 2026, to interested entities and persons on the Commission's PUC Weekly Filings electronic 
listserv. No petitions to intervene or comments were filed. On March 18, 2026, MidAmerican filed workpapers. 
The revised tariff sheet, effective for service rendered on or after April 2, 2026, is as follows: 
South Dakota Electric Tariff Schedule No. 2 
SD P.U.C. Sec. No. 3 
11 th Revised Sheet No. 73 
Canceling 10th Revised Sheet No. 73 
The Commission has jurisdiction over this matter pursuant to SDCL Chapter 49-34A, specifically 49-34A-
4, 49-34A-6, 49-34A-8, 49-34A-10, 49-34A-12, and 49-34A-25.1 through SDCL 49-34A-25.4, and ARSD 
20:10:13. 
At its regularly scheduled meeting on March 26, 2026, the Commission considered this matter. 
Commission staff recommended approval of the revised TCR rate factors and revised tariff sheet with an effective 
date of April 2, 2026. Having thoroughly reviewed the filings in the docket, the Commission found the TCR rates 
and tariff revisions to be just and reasonable. The Commission voted unanimously to approve the revised TCR 
rate factors and revised tariff sheet with an effective date of April 2, 2026. It is therefore 
ORDERED, that the revised TCR rate factors and revised tariff sheet set forth above are approved 
effective April 2, 2026.
